title: Pew
blurb: The most efficient onomatopoeia ever devised — a tiny laser noise that any human can produce with their own mouth and that everybody, without exception, finds funny. It is the sound of finger guns, imaginary blasters, and violence so obviously fictional that it carries no weight at all. That harmlessness is exactly why it works everywhere: there is no context in which a pew lands badly, and it costs the listener nothing emotionally. Deploy it liberally, in edits and in person. Small, silly, and undefeated since children first pointed at each other.
